description: Diagram AI. Describe a diagram in plain English via GET and get a rendered image back. Powered by AI. Credit cost: 10 credits per call.

diagram_type.description: Preferred diagram language. AI chooses if omitted. Examples: "mermaid", "d2", "plantuml", "graphviz". Allowed values: mermaid, d2, plantuml, graphviz. Default: "mermaid".

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

output_format.description: Output format. Default: "svg". Allowed values: svg, png, jpeg, pdf. Default: "svg".

prompt.description: Describe your diagram in plain English (max 1000 chars). Be specific: mention the diagram type, key entities, and relationships.

share.description: Set share=true to persist the config and receive JSON instead of an image: { id, render_url, view_url, embed_url, expires_in }. Free plan: 3-day expiry. Paid plan: 6-month expiry. Default: false.

name: diagram_ai
title: Diagram AI
